name: harmonyos-build-deploy
description: HarmonyOS build and deploy automation - one command to compile multi-module apps and install to real devices on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Auto-discovers hvigorw/hdc/ohpm/JBR from DevEco Studio (no PATH setup required), tolerant SDK version matching, product variants, build modes, dependency resolution, APP packaging for AppGallery, and pre-flight environment check.
author: supermanaaaa
